news.title: nightly-bisect/b: [AutoSP] Honor seq_dim when AutoSP shards inputs (#8720)
news.dek:
Split from  #8457 . 
 Problem 
 prepare_autosp_inputs()  takes a  seq_dim  argument, but only passes it 
to  mark_dynamic . The AutoSP graph passes ignore it: 
 pass_shard_seq_dim  and  shard_tensor_node  always read the sequence 
length from  shape[1]  and slice dimension 1. 
 S
news.aiSummary: The bug was that prepare_autosp_inputs() accepted a seq_dim argument but only forwarded it to mark_dynamic, while the AutoSP graph ignored it and always used shape[1] for the sequence length. This caused incorrect sharding of inputs. The fix ensures seq_dim is honored during sharding.

news.aiSummary: The update fixes CPUAdagrad to use the weight-decay-adjusted gradient for both the accumulator and parameter updates, aligning it with torch.optim.Adagrad.
